verdict.rationale: Penpot documents an official open plugin API that developers can build and publish extensions against. It also has a documented backend RPC API, with an auto-generated OpenAPI 3.0 spec and access-token authentication, that programmatic and AI consumers can target. However, no evidence shows packaged official SDK client libraries, for example npm or Python packages, or SDK reference docs. missing for 10: published official language SDK packages, SDK documentation and examples, independent hands-on corroboration of building against them.
